# Where to Watch Christian Mingle


by Angel | November 19, 2026


What happens when a woman who has everything going for her still can’t seem to find the right person? For busy executive Gwyneth Hayden, love has been harder to find than success. When she becomes the only single woman in her friend group, she decides to try something new: an online dating site called Christian Mingle.


What starts as a spur-of-the-moment decision soon leads Gwyneth to someone special. But as their relationship grows, his faith and values challenge the way she sees the world—and what she really wants out of love.


Starring Lacey Chabert, *Christian Mingle* is a sweet, lighthearted romantic comedy about dating, faith, and discovering what matters most.


[Stream Christian Mingle now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/christian-mingle)


### **A Sweet, Feel-Good Romantic Comedy**


With Lacey Chabert in the lead role, *Christian Mingle* brings a familiar rom-com setup together with a story about faith, honesty, and personal growth. It’s a lighthearted look at the surprises that can come with putting yourself out there—and finding someone who makes you see things differently.


Angel Guild members have called it “adorable,” “refreshing,” and the “cutest date movie!” If you’re in the mood for a sweet romance with a little heart, this one is worth a watch.


### **Watch** ***Christian Mingle*** **on Angel**


Sometimes, finding the right person means discovering something unexpected about yourself along the way. Follow Gwyneth’s search for love in *Christian Mingle* .
